name: on-page-seo-sidebar
description: Browser sidebar extension for local on-page SEO structured data analysis.

scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node scripts/package-store.mjs chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/package-store.mjs firefox
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:firefox && npm run build
